verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm that sells professional legal advisory services, not a software product with a UI and an API, so API-to-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence describes practice areas, an incubator programme and internal adoption of legaltech, and none of it shows the firm ships a customer-facing software interface or API that would make this axis apply.
